mapper.sql: SELECT p.PRTF_SN, p.USR_SN, p.PRTF_TTL, p.PRTF_CN, p.PRTF_REG_DT, p.PRTF_UPDT_DT, pf.FL_SN, f.FL_PATH, CASE WHEN pf.PRTF_FL_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IS_REPRESENTATIVE, pf.PRTF_FL_SORT_NO FROM PORTFOLIO p LEFT JOIN PORTFOLIO_FILE pf ON pf.PRTF_SN = p.PRTF_SN LEFT JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pf.FL_SN AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PORTFOLIO (USR_SN, PRTF_TTL, PRTF_CN, PRTF_REG_ID, PRTF_UPDT_ID) VALUES (#{userSn}, #{title}, #{content}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})

INSERT INTO PORTFOLIO_FILE (PRTF_SN, FL_SN, PRTF_FL_RPRS_YN, PRTF_FL_SORT_NO, PRTF_FL_REG_ID, PRTF_FL_UPDT_ID) VALUES
(#{portfolioSn}, #{fileId}, CASE WHEN #{index} = 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END, #{index}, #{actorId}, #{actorId})
